candidate_observations.address: Brislington Concourse, Bath Road, Bristol, BS4 5BQ
observed_facts: The property reports gross income of £189,227 across 23 shops and one flat, with four vacant units.
The schedule includes holding-over occupiers, a tenancy at will, a six-month flat tenancy and several 2026-2027 tenant breaks.
The property is held from Bristol City Council on two leases with approximately 69 and 71 years remaining at £10,200 total annual ground rent.
A 2023 feasibility study considered 96 apartments and eight shops, but the source does not state that planning permission was granted.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £189,227 headline was not treated as uniformly long-dated secure income. Vacant units received no rent, the £10,200 superior ground rent was kept separate and the feasibility study was not represented as planning permission or development value.

candidate_observations.address: 12-14 Butcher Row and 6-7 Ox Row, Salisbury, Wiltshire, SP1 1EP
observed_facts: Costa Limited, company 01270695, is active and pays £63,000 under a ten-year lease from 23 June 2017.
The lease ends on 22 June 2027 and the first and second floors provide 2,247 square feet of vacant accommodation.
The freehold property is Grade II listed and the upper-floor residential conversion opportunity remains subject to necessary consents.
The property is Sold Prior and no sale price is published.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £63,000 rent was not projected beyond June 2027. Vacant upper floors received no rent or residential value and conversion potential was not treated as permission.

candidate_observations.address: Holland and Barrett, 253 High Street, Bangor, Clwyd, LL57 1PB
observed_facts: Holland & Barrett Retail Limited, company 02758955, is active and pays £18,000 under a five-year lease from 24 February 2026.
The tenant may determine on the third anniversary of the term, before the nominal 23 February 2031 expiry.
The current July listing states a £175,000+ guide and a three-month rent-free period, with the seller compensating the buyer for rent from completion until that period ends.
The virtual freehold comprises two 999-year leases at peppercorn rent.
candidate_observations.guardrail: Income was not treated as secure beyond February 2029. Seller compensation was not represented as tenant-paid rent, and peppercorn superior rent was not counted as income.

candidate_observations.address: High Newham Court, Stockton-on-Tees, County Durham, TS19 8PD
observed_facts: The £46,334 total mixes occupational retail rents, residential ground rents, CCTV licence income and substation rent.
Units 22a and 22b are vacant, while several other units are held on peppercorn 999-year interests.
The landlord may determine several occupational leases on three months written notice, and one tenant is recorded as not currently trading from its unit.
The residential component includes 26 flats at £2,704 and one flat at £100, with scheduled long-period increases.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £46,334 total was not treated as one homogeneous long-dated covenant. Vacant units received no rent, peppercorn interests were not counted and landlord termination rights were preserved.

candidate_observations.address: Yates, 19-21 Silver Street, Halifax, West Yorkshire, HX1 1HS
observed_facts: Stonegate Pub Company Limited, company FC029833, is active and has an open UK establishment.
The property produces £131,127 under a no-break lease ending 28 August 2032.
The 2022 tenant break was not exercised, while the five-yearly upward-only review dated 29 August 2025 remains outstanding.
The property was Withdrawn Prior.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The outstanding 2025 review was not converted into a rent uplift. The unexercised 2022 break was recorded without extending the lease beyond August 2032.

candidate_observations.address: 39 Vineyard Path, Mortlake, Richmond Upon Thames, London, SW14 8EL
observed_facts: The current July listing offers the vacant 1,255-square-foot office at a £415,000 guide.
The property is held for 999 years from 25 March 1999 at £200 annual reserved rent.
The earlier May listing was Deferred; the current listing is Available under the later Acuitus identity.
Potential conversion to full residential use remains subject to consents.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £200 reserved rent was kept separate from occupational income. Residential conversion was not represented as granted permission or a completed value uplift.

observed_facts: The vacant Grade II listed former bank sold for £438,000.
The freehold provides approximately 3,996 square feet over three floors and includes a garage.
The sale is conditional and subject to confirmation by the seller under the Special Conditions of Sale.
Upper-floor conversion potential remains subject to planning and Listed Building consent.
